title: Animal Adaptation
notes: Let’s discuss some questions before starting this topic: i.
What might be the causes of migration in animals.
Have you ever seen bird migration in the sky.
The term migration is derived from a Latin word ‘Migrare’ which literally means ‘to travel or going from one place to another’.
Migration is the regular and periodic passing of animals from one place to another place for various purposes.
It is a complex type of inborn behaviour which is shown by insects, birds fishes, some mammals, turtle etc.
Animals migrate for various purposes viz.
in search of food, to protect from adverse environmental condition, to find mate, shelter and for reproduction.
